objective: Sell toning footwear using weight-loss and muscle-strengthening claims.
businessContext: Advertising used celebrity and expert-style endorsements for objective health-related claims.
strategy: Convert product design into promised fitness outcomes.
outcomes: Skechers agreed to provide $40 million for consumer refunds under an FTC settlement.
whatFailed: Objective benefit claims lacked adequate substantiation and a material relationship affecting an endorsement was not adequately disclosed.
transferConditions: Use when campaigns make measurable health or performance claims.
nonTransferConditions: Do not treat the settlement as evidence about ordinary subjective brand claims.

sources.title: FTC to Skechers: Shape up your ad claims
sources.methodology: Regulatory account of challenged claims, disclosures and settlement.
